mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline from their previous month's value.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by a 0.2 percentage point increase in FEDFUNDS over three months), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months and INDPRO declines from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 50th percentile historical level.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,000,000 units, it signals strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in total employment (PAYEMS) indicates a severe labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, thereby lowering corporate earnings growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by quarterly GDP growth exceeding 3.0% as measured by GDPC1), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic overheating that triggers a policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% and INDPRO declines from the previous month.
